subject: financial_literacy
concept: Distinguishing between a need (something you must have) and a want (something you'd like to have)
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts picture cards of items into 'need' and 'want' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an item to the correct category with a reason
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a specific item is a need or a want

misconception_flags: classifies a strongly desired want as a need

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
